extraction_type: Read-only archived evidence parsing, hashing and arithmetic comparison; no numerical experiments or package tests executed

provenance_root.label: accepted_baseline
provenance_root.path_rule: All source paths are relative to this root unless a run-relative map is explicitly named

original_build_environment.isolation: build --no-isolation in the dedicated bootstrap venv
original_build_environment.qualification: Versions linked through archived bootstrap install logs and the venv config; current metadata-only runtime probes confirmed these versions. The build receipt itself does not list tool versions.

reference_contract.description: Archived acceptance constants, not exact nonlinear integral ground truth; errors are recomputed from saved stdout only
reference_contract.state_order_note: Chronological slots are [0 h, 12 h]; manuscript omega_01 maps to bitstring 10, omega_10 to 01.

counts_summary.interpretation: 239 identical tests repeated in two wheel environments; not 478 distinct tests and not 239 tests for each sdist installation

portable_command_templates.substitution: Each {...} token is a caller-selected path, passed as one argv element, not a literal shell command.
portable_command_templates.pin_note: Append pins for the first run. The second run resolved unpinned against the then-current offline wheelhouse; exact replay should pin the recorded versions.
notes: Create fresh environments outside the immutable baseline; do not install into its archived venvs.
Extract the tested sdist into CONSUMER_DIR before running examples/tests. It uses a src layout.
VENV_PYTHON means Scripts/python.exe on Windows or bin/python on POSIX. POSIX compatibility is not established by these Windows runs.
Only the first final run built the original artifacts; the second reused that exact pair.
Rebuilding any repository state creates new artifacts requiring new hashes and clean-install evidence.

scope_limitations: Only the original 0.2.0 artifacts identified above are covered; no current-repository rebuild equivalence is asserted.
Only Windows AMD64 CPython 3.11.9 / NumPy 1.26.0 / SciPy 1.16.2 and CPython 3.12.0 / NumPy 2.5.4 / SciPy 1.18.1 were verified.
No macOS, Linux, other Python patch/minor versions, PyPy, or free-threaded compatibility evidence is supplied.
The label final_py312_latest is historical; it is not a claim about currently newest dependency versions.
The 239-test installed suite ran only against the wheel, not the sdist-installed package; both installations ran the complete OXC/TAC references.
These Laplace reference differences are regression agreement, not a bound on approximation error or proof of clinical accuracy.
No live NONMEM, external R aghq, complete sensitivity matrix, or five-repeat formal experiment was executed by this extraction or established by these two installation runs.
Retained prior-centered GHQ is not an integrated R aghq backend; high-order TAC GHQ accuracy remains unaccepted in the baseline report.
Separate 28-test local and 12-test static audits mentioned by the baseline report are outside this two-run extraction and not added to its counts.
Earlier failed build/install attempts are retained in the baseline; final-run success does not erase them.
No remote publication, CI execution, or current-repository validation is claimed.
The original build stderr contains manifest-pruning and disabled-bytecompilation warnings; its exit code was zero. Installation/reference/regression stderr files were empty.
Original source archives may contain historical development material; this report includes only selected evidence, not internal prompt contents.
